chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Isma'il ibn Marar from Yunus from Isma'il ibn Abd al-Khalic said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'There is no harm for the elderly man, the sick person, the woman, and the infirm to hasten the Tawaf of Hajj before they depart to Mina.'

key_terms.طَوَافَ الْحَجِّ: Tawaf of Hajj (specifically the circumambulation performed after standing at Arafat/Mina)

ai.seo_question: Can the elderly and sick perform Hajj Tawaf before going to Mina?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), establishing a legal concession (rukhsah) that allows the elderly, sick, women, and the infirm to perform Tawaf al-Ifadah before departing for Mina. This ruling alleviates the physical burden of the crowded post-stay rituals, reflecting the Shia juristic principle of easing religious obligations for those with genuine hardship, a concept deeply rooted in the Prophetic tradition of flexibility during Hajj.
